title: Press to Gather - Configurable
author: Tic0311 and CamilleBC
summary: Hold B / Circle to gather nearby harvestable resources, or press O. Choose your controller button and a 10–200 m distance in the optional Mod Settings menu. Defaults: 0.6-second hold and 20 m. Supports Framecore UE4SS Performance mode.

file.name: Press to Gather - Configurable
file.description: Choose your gather button in the optional Mod Settings menu. Hold B / Circle for 0.6 seconds by default, or press O. Default distance 20 m; configure 10–200 m in 10 m steps using the menu or settings.ini. Supports Framecore UE4SS Performance mode.
